title: Checkpoint III: Minimum Processing Rate
prerequisite: Lessons 12–15. The relevant pattern is intentionally not announced.
hints: For a proposed rate, total required hours is the sum of ceil(job / rate) across all jobs.
Feasibility is monotonic: once a rate is fast enough, every larger rate is also fast enough. Binary-search that boundary.
Search positive rates from 1 through max(jobs), keeping a feasible midpoint as a candidate and continuing left.
